symptom: After forwardVaultDigest began rejecting invalid records before canonicalization, ten existing negative tests still required old canonicalizer-specific error-message regexes; GitHub CI verify failed although invalid inputs continued to throw TypeError.
lesson: When admission validation moves ahead of canonicalization, invalid input still fails closed but the first thrown TypeError message changes. Negative tests should assert the stable error type and non-execution side effects, not an incidental internal message.
guardrail: For digest validation regressions, assert TypeError as the public failure contract; retain explicit invalid-record validation, append rejection, getter non-execution and valid-digest idempotency checks. After admission-order changes, run all existing negative tests under official PR CI before claiming success.
